name: Cosmic CRF Limited
summary: Cosmic CRF Limited offers a comprehensive range of hot and cold rolled stainless steel products. Its extensive product lineup features hot and cold rolled sheets, coated coils, various tubes, rebars, wire rods, specialized automotive steels, and diverse building solutions. A primary focus for the firm is the provision of fabricated components for the railway sector, including coaches and wagons. They also supply cold rolled formed items tailored for wagons, coaches, infrastructure firms, and Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects, in addition to essential products for roadways and national highways. Established on December 21, 2021, the company is headquartered in Kolkata, India.
